columns.t: 1 pound potatoes, peeled and diced into 1/4-inch cubes (Yukon Gold recommended)
1 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste
1-2 teaspoons hot sauce, plus more for serving (such as sriracha)
For serving: non-fat plain Greek yogurt or sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, cooked brown rice or cauliflower rice, and extra hot sauce
Heat in a large skillet over high heat. Once hot and shiny, reduce heat to medium.
Add and cook, stirring often, until golden and beginning to soften, about 6 minutes.
Add and cook, breaking apart the meat.
Add seasonings. Continue cooking and breaking up the beef until the potatoes and onions are tender and the beef is fully cooked, about 6–8 minutes.
Stir in. Taste and adjust the salt and pepper as desired.
Serve hot with desired toppings, over rice, or on its own.
